title: THURSDAY INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY. STEP-UPS, INCLINE PUSH-UPS, SLOW MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS, BIRD-DOG BALANCE, HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH, WALL CHEST OPENER. SHORT HONEST EFFORTS, THEN WE OPEN THE HIPS AND CHEST.

script.welcome: THURSDAY, GRIMES. INTERVALS. SIXTEEN MINUTES. SHORT BURSTS, PROPER FORM, THEN WE UNKNOT THE HIPS AND CHEST THAT DESK HAS BEEN STRANGLING. NOT A FAT BURNING CIRCUS. A TUNE UP. ON YOUR FEET.
script.rest: REST. CATCH YOUR BREATH, NOT YOUR EMAIL.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT THE BEST ONE. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. LEGS, ARMS, BALANCE, HIPS AND CHEST, ALL ACCOUNTED FOR. GOCHUJANG CHICKEN TONIGHT, GRIMES. LOAD THE PLATE WITH CHICKEN AND VEG, GO EASY ON THE RICE, AND NO RAIDING THE CRACKERS AFTER. PROTEIN AT LUNCH. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS (BOTTOM STAIR)
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL, STAND TALL AT THE TOP, STEP DOWN UNDER CONTROL. ALTERNATE LEADING LEGS. HANDRAIL FINGERTIP IS FINE. STEADY PACE FOR 30 SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. BOTTOM STAIR. THREE ROUNDS OF THIRTY SECONDS. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, PUSH THROUGH THE HEEL, STAND UP TALL, STEP DOWN SOFT. SWAP LEGS. STEADY, GRIMES. YOU ARE CLIMBING A STAIR, NOT FLEEING A TAX MAN.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. LEGS AWAKE. GOOD.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, SLIGHTLY WIDER THAN SHOULDERS. BODY ONE STRAIGHT LINE, HEAD TO HEELS, BELLY TIGHT. LOWER THE CHEST TO THE EDGE, ELBOWS AT ABOUT 45 DEGREES, PRESS AWAY. SMOOTH REPS FOR 30 SECONDS; PAUSE AT THE TOP IF NEEDED.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS OF THIRTY SECONDS. HANDS ON THE STEP, BODY LIKE A PLANK OF OAK, CHEST DOWN TO THE EDGE, PUSH AWAY. NO SAGGING HIPS. IF YOU NEED A BREATHER, REST AT THE TOP, NOT ON YOUR BELLY.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. CHEST AND ARMS SERVED. GOOD.

exercises.name: SLOW MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, BODY IN A STRAIGHT INCLINE PLANK. DRIVE ONE KNEE TOWARD THE CHEST, RETURN, SWITCH. SLOW AND CONTROLLED, HIPS LEVEL, SHOULDERS OVER HANDS. 20 SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. SLOW ONES. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS OF TWENTY SECONDS. KNEE TO CHEST, BACK, SWAP. HIPS STILL, CORE TIGHT. THIS IS MARCHING, NOT A DANCE OFF.
exercises.speakDone: CLIMBERS DONE. HEART RATE UP, NOBODY DIED. GOOD.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG BALANCE
exercises.cue: ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG BACK UNTIL LEVEL. HIPS SQUARE, BACK FLAT. HOLD TWO SECONDS, RETURN SLOW, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. BALANCE WORK. TWO ROUNDS, FIVE EACH SIDE. ARM FORWARD, OPPOSITE LEG BACK, HOLD TWO SECONDS. HIPS LEVEL. PRETEND THERE'S A CUP OF TEA ON YOUR BACK AND I WANT IT UNSPILT.
exercises.speakDone: BIRD DOG DONE. TEA SAFE. GOOD.

exercises.name: HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH WITH REACH
exercises.cue: HALF-KNEEL, BACK KNEE ON A FOLDED TOWEL, FRONT FOOT FLAT. TUCK THE TAILBONE, SQUEEZE THE BACK GLUTE, SHIFT HIPS GENTLY FORWARD. REACH THE SAME-SIDE ARM AS THE BACK KNEE UP AND SLIGHTLY OVER. NO ARCHING. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. HALF KNEEL, TUCK THE TAIL, SQUEEZE THE BACK CHEEK, EASE FORWARD, ARM UP AND OVER. EIGHT HOURS IN A CHAIR HAS FOLDED YOU LIKE A DECKCHAIR, GRIMES. UNFOLD.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO THE WALL. FOREARM FLAT ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT. STEP THE NEAR FOOT FORWARD AND SLOWLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, TURN THE CHEST AWAY. SHOULDER DOWN AWAY FROM THE EAR. UNDO THE KEYBOARD HUNCH.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN, SHOULDERS BACK. THAT IS THURSDAY DONE. DISMISSED.
